name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 65 – Am 75
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 65b. Warns about the worrying reported levels of corruption in Ukraine; reaffirms its opposition to Ukraine’s fast-track accession to the EU, as the current climate in the country is incompatible with the principles of the Copenhagen Criteria; points out that Ukraine’s accession to the EU would lead to irreversible damage for European agriculture;
